name: OIDC social login
summary: Coordinate OIDC authorization-code social login around go-oidc with consume-once state and account bindings.
use_when: A product needs Google/Apple (or other OIDC issuer) browser login linked to a thin account registry.
non_goals: Non-OIDC OAuth providers (e.g. GitHub without ID token)
proposed_guarantees: Redirect URIs are configured absolutes (https or loopback http)
ID token verified before Identity is returned
failure_modes: Redirect URI derived from request Host

evidence.basis: Original OIDC coordinator CANDIDATE around go-oidc / x/oauth2; not a session store.

alternatives.name: coreos/go-oidc
alternatives.assessment: Use the maintained verifier; this package coordinates state, bindings and redirect policy.

open_questions: GitHub/Apple/Microsoft adapters landed under oidc/*; tenant IdP registry still deferred.
